in_sanskrit.name: Sabu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, King
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sabu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sabu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sabha' which means 'assembly' or 'council'. It is also the name of the mythological sage Sabari, who is known for her devotion and wisdom. Sabu is a powerful name that signifies strength, leadership, and joy.
